title: Page refreshes too often
description: The page reloads too often even when there are no updates.

title: Allow inline editing of Status and Priority in the bead table
description: Add inline dropdowns directly in the Status and Priority columns of the bead list table. Clicking a cell opens a select without needing to open the detail drawer. Calls bd update on change.
close_reason: Implemented: inline MUI Select for Status and Priority in BeadList table with optimistic updates

title: Add Docker healthchecks to docker-compose.yml
description: Add HEALTHCHECK instructions so Docker Desktop shows container health status and the frontend container waits for the backend to be ready before starting. Backend check: GET /health. Frontend check: nginx -t or curl localhost.
close_reason: Implemented and deployed

title: Comments on beads
description: Surface bd comments <id> output in the bead detail drawer. Allow adding new comments via the web UI using bd comment add (if supported). Comments are already stored in the Dolt database.
close_reason: Implemented and deployed

title: Export all beads of a project as CSV or JSON
description: Add an Export button on the project page that downloads every bead (all fields, including labels, dependencies and comments) as CSV or JSON. Backend endpoint runs bd export and converts the JSONL.
close_reason: Added GET /api/projects/{id}/export?format=json|csv (backed by bd export, all fields incl. comments/labels/deps) and an Export button with JSON/CSV menu on the project page

title: Manual refresh only + lightweight resource audit
description: Remove all timed/background refreshing (SSE file watcher, 30s polling, EventSource) so data only reloads on explicit Refresh button or after update commands. Audit and reduce CPU/memory usage: bd spawn concurrency, healthcheck cadence, theme memoization, container memory limits.
close_reason: Removed SSE/polling, added manual Refresh buttons, capped bd concurrency, slowed healthchecks, added memory limits, memoized theme, split chunks

title: Pin/sync bd CLI version in backend Docker image
description: backend/Dockerfile installs @beads/bd unpinned (npm install -g @beads/bd), so the container's bd version drifts from whatever the host bd has been upgraded to. When the host bd upgrades a project's Dolt storage format ahead of a stale container image, the old bd binary doesn't error gracefully - it panics (e.g. 'cannot create context from nil parent') instead of showing a version-mismatch error. Hit this on 2026-09-04 when host bd was 1.2.2 but the container image (built 2 months earlier) had 1.0.5, causing 'Project not initialized with bd' errors for a newly-added project (G:\KeWoW\azerothcore-wotlk) that had been managed with the newer host bd.
acceptance_criteria: Either pin @beads/bd to a specific version in backend/Dockerfile and document the process for bumping it, or add a startup/health check that detects a bd version mismatch against project data and surfaces a clear error instead of a panic/crash.

title: Rework bead interaction: remove side panel, row opens edit modal, quick comment button
description: Remove BeadDetail drawer. Row click opens expanded BeadForm (edit modal). Replace the row end button with a quick-add-comment button. Expand BeadForm to cover all fields (status, AC, notes) plus an inline comments section.
close_reason: Side panel removed, full edit modal + quick comment button deployed

title: Differentiate color schemes more visually across the UI
description: The 10 color schemes currently only affect the project card top border and a few accent colours. Extend the theme so each scheme has a distinct look: different background tones, card surfaces, and sidebar/header colouring so switching schemes feels meaningfully different.
close_reason: Per-scheme bg/paper/divider colors deployed

title: Add some quick stats to each project tile in the Projects page
description: The project tile should contain an overview of the bead statuses.
close_reason: Stats row added to project tiles with lazy loading and skeleton

title: Improve Type display with icons and make filter multi-select
description: Replace plain text type labels with a TypeChip component (icon + colour). Update the Type filter in BeadList to multi-select, matching the Status filter UX.
close_reason: TypeChip with icons + multi-select type filter deployed

title: Copy bead ID to clipboard from table and detail panel
description: Add a small copy-to-clipboard button next to the bead ID in both the table row and the detail drawer. Button briefly shows a checkmark after copying.
close_reason: Implemented CopyIconButton in table row and detail drawer

title: Change status filter to multi-select, default to all except closed and deferred
description: Replace the single-value Status dropdown in the bead table filter bar with a multi-select. Default selection: open, in_progress, blocked, pinned. Empty selection shows all beads.
close_reason: Implemented: MUI multi-select with checkboxes, defaults to open/in_progress/blocked/pinned

title: Add Joi input validation to backend routes
description: The POST /api/projects and POST /api/projects/:id/beads routes accept unvalidated payloads. Add @hapi/joi validation schemas to reject malformed input early and return 400 with clear messages instead of letting errors bubble up from bd.

title: Cross-project search
description: Add a global search bar on the home page that queries bd list across all registered projects and shows results grouped by project. Useful when you remember a bead title but not which project it belongs to.
close_reason: Removed from backlog — out of scope for now

title: Dashboard with bead counts by status and priority
description: Add a summary dashboard on the project page showing bead counts grouped by status (open, in_progress, blocked, closed) and by priority. Gives an at-a-glance health view of the project.
close_reason: Implemented BeadDashboard showing counts by status and priority

title: bd list omits closed beads in the web UI
description: The backend calls 'bd list --json' without --all, so closed beads are never returned. The web UI should show all beads and let the user filter.
close_reason: Fixed: bd list now called with --all --limit 0

title: Bead list shows blank lines instead of bead data
description: The project page loads successfully and shows rows, but all cells are empty. The bd list --json output format likely doesn't match the field names the frontend expects.
close_reason: Fixed: all PascalCase field refs updated to snake_case to match bd JSON output; getBead now unwraps the array from bd show

title: Internal server error when opening a project page
description: Clicking a project tile shows 'An internal server error occurred'. Root cause: bd CLI is not available inside the Docker container, and Hapi masks 5xx error messages so the real reason is hidden.
close_reason: Fixed: install @beads/bd via npm in Dockerfile; replace Boom.badImplementation with Boom.serverUnavailable

title: Beads-manager frontend port collided with brax-revamp dev server on 3000
description: Both beads-manager's docker-compose frontend port mapping and brax-revamp's local (non-docker) API dev server (npm run dev:api, tsx) were bound to port 3000 on the Windows host. Hitting 127.0.0.1:3000 was routed to whichever process's socket answered first (usually the stray brax-revamp node process), returning a 404 JSON that looked identical to beads-manager's own Hapi 404 format, making it look like the app was broken. Remapped beads-manager frontend to host port 3002 to avoid future collisions.
close_reason: Remapped beads-manager frontend from host port 3000 to 3002 in docker-compose.yml to avoid collision with brax-revamp's local dev server; verified working

title: Fix frontend Docker healthcheck using unresolvable localhost/IPv6
description: The frontend container's healthcheck ran 'wget http://localhost/' inside the Alpine nginx container. /etc/hosts resolves localhost to ::1 first, but nginx only binds 0.0.0.0:80 (IPv4), so the healthcheck always failed with connection-refused and the container was permanently marked unhealthy, even though the app served requests correctly.
close_reason: Fixed healthcheck to use 127.0.0.1 instead of localhost; frontend container now reports healthy

title: Persist bead list scroll position and filters across navigation
description: When a user opens a bead detail drawer and closes it, or navigates back from a sub-page, the status/type filters and scroll position reset. Persist filter state in URL search params (?status=open&type=bug) so the browser back button restores context.

title: Remove obsolete version field from docker-compose.yml
description: docker-compose.yml has 'version: 3.8' which is now obsolete in Docker Compose v2 and produces a warning on every startup. Remove the field.
close_reason: Implemented and deployed

title: Auto-refresh bead list when project files change
description: Poll or use fs.watch on the project's .beads/issues.jsonl file from the backend and push updates to the frontend via Server-Sent Events (SSE). This way the list stays fresh when bd is used from the CLI in parallel.
close_reason: SSE stream + fs.watchFile polling + nginx config deployed

title: Bead dependency graph view
description: Visualize bead dependencies using bd graph output. Show a DAG (directed acyclic graph) of blocking/blocked-by relationships on the project page. Could use a lightweight library like d3-dag or react-flow.
